scenarios.name: text-01 Commit the intended result

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is running
an editable planar sketch
the user selects Text, place its insertion location, enter a short string, and accept the format dialog
the character remains with its accepted formatting after Escape
the dimensions-needed count changes from 210 to 215

scenarios.name: text-02 Observe empty-content acceptance

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is running
an editable planar sketch
an empty text editor is open in an editable sketch
the user clicks OK
the editor closes without validation or visible text
the placement prompt remains with 28 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: text-04 Undo and redo a committed change

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is running
an editable planar sketch
the user has committed one valid change through this feature
the user has exited the creation or edit command
the user presses Ctrl+Z once
the last feature transaction is undone
the user presses Ctrl+Y once
that transaction is restored
the visible text and solver count return to their pre-undo state

scenarios.name: text-05 Start another placement after content cancellation

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is running
an editable planar sketch
the earlier new text containing a was canceled
the user starts Text and choose another insertion point
the new editor is empty
the font is Tahoma, height is 3.05 mm and width is 100

scenarios.name: text-06 Cancel pending text after live preview

scenario_steps.name: an editable sketch with 210 dimensions needed
the user starts Text and select insertion location (450,650)
Format Text opens with an empty editor and Tahoma, 3.05 mm and width 100
the user focuses the editor and press lowercase a
a appears in the editor and the live canvas preview
the user clicks Cancel
Format Text closes and the pending text preview disappears
Text remains available for placement
the user presses Escape
the creation command exits without retained text or solver-count change

scenarios.name: text-07 Commit text and undo and redo the creation transaction

scenario_steps.name: an editable sketch and Text is active
the user selects insertion location (450,650)
the user focuses the empty Format Text editor and press lowercase b
b appears in the editor and live canvas preview
the user clicks OK and press Escape
b remains visible and the sketch returns Ready
the user presses Ctrl+Z
the new b text disappears and the baseline state returns
the user presses Ctrl+Y
b returns with its original visible appearance and position

scenarios.name: text-08 Canceled new text does not populate the next text editor

scenario_steps.name: the user canceled new text containing lowercase a without accepting it
the user starts Text again and choose a new insertion location
Format Text opens with an empty content editor
the user records the retained formatting defaults separately from content

scenarios.name: text-09 Cancel replacement of existing text content

scenario_steps.name: committed b text and Ready sketch state
the user right-clicks the glyph and choose Edit text
Format Text opens containing b and its current formatting
the user focuses the editor, press Ctrl+A, and type c
c replaces b in the editor and live canvas preview
the user clicks Cancel
the original b returns on the canvas
the sketch returns directly to Ready with its baseline solver count
no new text object is created

scenarios.name: text-10 Accept replacement content and reverse the edit transaction

scenario_steps.name: the b text remains after a canceled c replacement
the user chooses Edit text again
Format Text contains b
the user focuses the editor, press Ctrl+A, type c, and click OK
c replaces b and the sketch returns directly to Ready
the solver count remains at its pre-edit value
the user presses Ctrl+Z
b returns without removing the text object
the user presses Ctrl+Y
c returns at the same visible location

scenarios.name: text-11 Cancel bold formatting applied to selected existing content

scenario_steps.name: unbolded c text and Ready sketch state
the user chooses Edit text, focus the editor, and press Ctrl+A
the user clicks the Bold control
Bold is highlighted and c thickens in the editor and live preview
the character content remains c
the user clicks Cancel
the original thinner c returns and the sketch is Ready
the baseline solver count is retained

scenarios.name: text-12 Observe empty-content OK

scenario_steps.name: Text has opened an empty Format Text editor in the 28-dimension fixture
the user clicks OK without entering content
the editor closes without a validation dialog or visible text
the placement prompt remains with 28 dimensions needed
the user chooses the same insertion location
the new editor is empty

scenarios.name: text-13 Commit bold characters and restore creation history

scenario_steps.name: the new Text editor is empty with Tahoma and 3.05 mm
the user presses a then b separately
the user selects both characters and click Bold
the editor and live preview thicken without changing the entered characters
the user clicks OK then press Escape
the bold text remains at Ready with 33 dimensions needed
the user undoes creation
the text disappears and 28 dimensions needed returns
the user redoes creation
the bold result returns with 33 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: text-14 Inspect retained bold formatting after Redo

scenario_steps.name: the bold text creation was restored by Redo
the user double-clicks the text in one supported gesture
Format Text shows Bold highlighted, Tahoma, 3.05 mm and both entered characters
the user cancels the unchanged editor
the accepted text remains

scenarios.name: text-15 Undo and redo an accepted existing-text formatting edit

scenario_steps.name: existing bold characters
the user reopens Text, focus the editor and select both characters
the user applies Italic and accept
slanted bold characters remain at Ready with 33 dimensions needed
the user undoes
upright bold characters remain
the user redoes
the slanted appearance returns without changing the 33-dimension count

scenarios.name: text-16 Insert a model parameter after supported drag placement

scenario_steps.name: Text is active in Part6 Sketch2
the user drags from 1050,800 to 1250,900 and release
an empty Format Text editor opens
the user focuses the editor and insert the displayed d0 model parameter
a shaded 10.000 field appears without digit entry
the user accepts and exit repeated placement
the displayed value remains at Ready with 38 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: text-17 Update linked Text by changing its source dimension

scenario_steps.name: Text displays the inserted d0 value 10.000
the user opens the dimension identified as d0
the user enters 1 then 2 and accept
its source annotation is 12 and Text displays 12.000
the user undoes the source edit
the source and Text return to 10 and 10.000 respectively

scenarios.name: text-18 Observe font and height selection previews

scenario_steps.name: existing bold italic characters are selected in Format Text
the user opens the font list and choose Arial
the font field shows Arial and the preview changes
the user opens the height list and choose 6.10 mm
the preview enlarges and the height field shows 6.10 mm

scenarios.name: text-19 Accept underline, color and width formatting

scenario_steps.name: the selected Text preview and its formatting controls
the user enables Underline and open Color
the user selects a blue basic swatch and accept Color
Format Text shows a blue swatch
the user replaces width 100 with separately entered digits 5 and 0 and press Tab
width is 50 and the preview changes
the user accepts Format Text
blue underlined characters remain on canvas

scenarios.name: text-20 Inspect actual formatting after saved document reopening

scenario_steps.name: the formatted Text and model-value Text were finished and saved
the user closes Part6, reopen it and edit Sketch2 in the same application session
both text objects remain and the sketch shows 38 dimensions needed
the user reopens the blue Text editor and observe its settled state
height is 6.10 mm, width is 50 and the color swatch is blue
Bold, Italic and Underline are highlighted
the font field shows Tahoma rather than the earlier Arial preview
the user cancels the unchanged editor
the saved text remains

scenarios.name: text-21 Preview centered and middle-aligned Text with double spacing

scenario_steps.name: the existing Text content is selected
the user selects center horizontal and middle vertical alignment
the selected controls are highlighted and canvas placement changes
the user opens line spacing
Single is checked and Double, 1.5 Lines, Multiple and Exactly are offered
the user chooses Double
the displayed editor rows have increased separation

scenarios.name: text-22 Preview numeric numbering and a diameter symbol

scenario_steps.name: the selected Text preview
the user opens the numbering dropdown
numeric, lower and upper alphabetic, and lower and upper Roman styles are offered
the user chooses numeric numbering
a 1. prefix and indentation appear for the content
the user positions the caret at the end and insert diameter from the symbol palette
the diameter symbol appears in the editor and preview

scenarios.name: text-23 Cancel the combined paragraph and symbol edits

scenario_steps.name: alignment, spacing, numbering and diameter insertion are only previewed
the user clicks Cancel in Format Text
the saved unnumbered character content and placement return
the blue underline and linked 10.000 remain
Ready shows 38 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: text-24 Cancel inline preset naming and inspect settings

scenario_steps.name: Format Text shows No Preset
the user opens the preset list
No Preset and Last Used are offered
the user dismisses it, click plus and press Escape
proposed inline name ab is canceled and No Preset returns
the user opens preset settings
current-preset save, rename and delete are disabled
Recently Used sort order and No Preset new-text default are checked

scenarios.name: text-25 Compare selected and unselected case conversion

scenario_steps.name: existing lowercase ab is unselected
the user chooses UPPERCASE
the lowercase content remains
the user focuses and select the content and choose UPPERCASE
AB appears in the editor and preview
the user enables strike-through
a line crosses the selected uppercase characters

scenarios.name: text-26 Inspect Text Box orientation and background fill defaults

scenario_steps.name: the identified Text Box control
the user clicks it and open its newly enabled selector
four orientation glyph choices appear
the user chooses the second option and center the preview
the RIGHT-view text becomes horizontally readable
the user opens Background Fill
Fill Color has Sheet Color checked and color controls unavailable
the user cancels Fill Color
Format Text returns without a fill-color edit

scenarios.name: text-27 Commit paragraph and symbol edits and restore history

scenario_steps.name: the centered uppercase and strike-through preview
the user positions the caret at the end and use the remembered diameter button
the user accepts Format Text
horizontal blue AB with diameter remains at Ready with 35 dimensions needed
linked Text still displays 10.000
the user undoes
the prior lowercase vertical baseline returns with 38 dimensions needed
the user redoes
the combined uppercase symbol result returns with 35 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: text-28 Stack selected fraction input

scenario_steps.name: the existing blue Text is open in Format Text
the user replaces its content with the characters 1, slash, and 2
the user selects the fraction and click the enabled stack control
the preview displays 1 above 2
the user accepts the dialog
the stacked fraction remains and the status shows 35 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: text-29 Restore fraction replacement through history

scenario_steps.name: an accepted stacked fraction
the user presses Undo
the previous AB diameter content returns
the user presses Redo
the stacked fraction returns with 35 dimensions needed
the linked Text remains 10.000

scenarios.name: text-30 Save and apply a named content preset

scenario_steps.name: the existing stacked fraction is open in Format Text
the user creates and confirm inline preset name f
the user cancels the unchanged existing-text editor
the user starts a fresh Text placement
the fresh editor initially shows No Preset and empty content
the user selects f from the preset list
the fraction content and blue formatting appear in the fresh placement
the controls show Arial, 6.10 mm, and width 50
the user inspects and dismiss preset settings without changing them
the user accepts the dialog and press Escape
a second fraction remains with 37 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: text-31 Rename and save the modified preset

scenario_steps.name: reopened preset-derived Text shows *f
the user chooses Rename Current and replace the inline name with g
the user confirms the name
the selector shows *g
the user chooses Save Current
the selector shows g without the leading asterisk

scenarios.name: text-32 Observe and restore new Text preset defaults

scenario_steps.name: the saved preset g
the user selects Use Current Preset as the new Text default and cancel the existing-text editor
the user starts another placement
g and its fraction content appear automatically
the user selects Last Used, cancel, and place again
the fraction preview returns with the clock-marked *g selector
Last Used is checked in settings
the user restores No Preset, cancel, and place again
the editor is empty with Tahoma 3.05 mm, purple and width 100
the saved preset g remains listed

scenarios.name: text-33 Apply bullets and sequential numbering to actual paragraphs

scenario_steps.name: the restored No Preset editor is empty
the user focuses the editor and press a, Return, and b
the user selects both paragraphs and click Bullets
each paragraph has a bullet marker
the user chooses numeric numbering
the editor shows 1. for a and 2. for b
the user clicks OK and press Escape
the numbered Text remains and Ready shows 42 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: text-34 Insert a standard filename property and inspect unavailable parameter sources

scenario_steps.name: a fresh empty Format Text editor in Part6
the user opens Type and select Standard iProperties
Source shows the primary Part6 model and Precision is unavailable
the user selects FILENAME, focus the editor, and click Insert
the editor shows a shaded FILENAME field and the canvas shows the current document filename
the user selects Parameters - Finish
Source is empty and no parameter is available in this fixture
the user selects Parameters - User
Source is Part6 and no parameter is available in this fixture
the inserted filename field remains

scenarios.name: text-35 Accept mixed fields with two-decimal model precision

scenario_steps.name: the filename property remains in the fresh editor
the user selects Parameters - Model and inspect Precision
zero through eight decimal examples are offered
the user chooses the two-decimal example
the user focuses the editor, move to its end, press Return, and insert d0
the added model field displays 10.00
the user accepts Format Text and press Escape
the current document filename and 10.00 remain in separate paragraphs at Ready
the earlier linked Text still displays 10.000
the status shows 47 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: text-36 Reject zero width and recover the formatting editor

scenario_steps.name: the existing fraction editor shows width 50
the user focuses width, select its value, enter 0, and press Tab
a separate out-of-expected-range warning appears
the user acknowledges the warning
zero is selected for correction
the user enters 5 then 0 and press Tab
width 50 is displayed without another warning

scenarios.name: text-37 Reject zero height and cancel the edit

scenario_steps.name: the existing fraction editor shows height 6.10 mm
the user selects height, enter 0, and press Tab
the application requests a size greater than .01 mm
the user acknowledges the message, enter 6, and press Tab
the height display returns to 6.10 mm
the font field shows Arial
the user cancels the editor
the fraction remains and Ready shows 47 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: text-38 Retain expanded Text content after saved reopening

scenario_steps.name: Sketch2 contains both stacked fractions, numbered paragraphs, and mixed property/model Text
the user finishes the sketch and save Part6
the user closes and reopen the saved document in the same application session
the user chooses Edit Sketch for Sketch2
both stacked fractions remain
the two numbered paragraphs retain a and b with prefixes 1. and 2.
the mixed field resolves to the current document filename and 10.00
the earlier linked field remains 10.000
Ready shows 47 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: text-39 Delete the preset while retaining accepted Text

scenario_steps.name: preset g exists and is selected
the reopened second fraction shows g
the user opens preset settings and choose Delete Current
No Preset replaces g without an additional application confirmation window
the fraction content remains in the editor
the user opens the preset list
g is absent and No Preset and Last Used remain
the user dismisses the list and cancel the unchanged editor
both accepted fractions and the other text remain
Ready shows 47 dimensions needed
